PM Modi Lays Foundation Stone for Gurudwara Redevelopment in Manila

Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited the 124-year-old Khalsa Diwan Gurudwara in Manila, Philippines, and laid the foundation stone for its redevelopment. The Gurudwara is described as the oldest in the Philippines.
